fix_options.label: Waitall on TAGBAD and skip the refusing rank in the abort loop (recommended)

fix_options.tradeoffs: Local to the root; protocol unchanged for receivers.

fix_options.label: Make the refusing receiver consume the abortion message
fix_options.summary: Post a matching zero-byte recv on the receiver.
fix_options.tradeoffs: Couples correctness to a message the root may not send; pending root sends still need waiting.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: He fixes the sender side, not the receiver, here.
